node.name: HP USA COLLEGE TOUR: EXPLORING TOMORROW, EMPOWERING TODAY
node.descriptionText:
At a time of rapid transformation in how we learn, design, engineer, and create, the HP USA College Tour  brings together students, educators, technology partners, and industry  leaders to explore the future of innovation. Through a unique  combination of hands-on experiences and real-world insights, the tour  showcases how emerging technologies are reshaping creative and technical  workflows across industries.

​Each event will feature a dynamic mix of workshops, industry keynotes, student showcases, technical demonstrations, and interactive activations, creating opportunities for students to engage directly with the technologies and professionals driving the future of work.

​Alongside HP, leading technology and software partners including Intel, AMD, Bentley Systems, and SOLIDWORKS  will showcase the latest advancements powering architecture,  engineering, design, manufacturing, visualization, and AI-driven  workflows. Students will gain firsthand exposure to cutting-edge  hardware platforms, professional software tools, and industry best  practices used by leading organizations around the world.

node.name: Creating Space: Mindfulness and Reflective Writing for Well-Being in Academia
node.descriptionText:
Feeling stretched thin by the demands of academic life? When was the last time you paused long enough to ask yourself how you are really doing? Between experiments, manuscripts, grant deadlines, mentoring, and the uncertainty of what comes next, postdoc and postgrad life leaves little room to check in with yourself.



This is your chance to breathe, write, and reset. In this hands-on session, we'll explore the science behind the benefits of mindfulness and journaling, then test the waters with breathwork exercises and writing prompts. You’ll reflect on the question "What am I carrying?", be guided through a calming body scan, and dip into positive psychology with a tool called Three Good Things.



You don’t need any journaling or meditation experience. All of the exercises are invitational, so you are welcome to do as much or as little as feels comfortable. You’ll leave with a set of simple, practical tools that can fit into even the busiest day.


Lunch will be served.


Bio

Sabrina Woods is a Holistic Career Coach & International Trainer / Speaker with a prior combined 20 years in the career services field at Northeastern and Harvard. She uses holistic and mindfulness-based practices to help individuals navigate major career and life transitions. Sabrina facilitates workshops on topics such as mindfulness, salary negotiation, and Linkedin, which she has taught in the US, UK, and Middle East for institutions such as MIT, Columbia and Harvard Medical School. Her workshops combine her insights, enthusiasm, and infectious energy. For more information, visit www.sabrina-woods.com.

node.name: POSTPONED: Hike to the Top of East Rock Park
node.descriptionText:
Join the Office of Sustainability and OISS for a leisurely walk to the summit of East Rock Park!

Prior to the ascent, we'll share information about the history of the park, as well as environmental stewardship, advocacy, and community engagement efforts.

We'll meet outside the Trowbridge Environmental Center, close to the intersection of Orange Street and Cold Spring Street. Please bring a water bottle and comfortable shoes and clothes. The event will take approximately 2 hours. A communication will be sent out to registered participants the day before to confirm weather status.

Registration is required for this program, which is open to graduate students and the international community. This event is open to adults only (18+).

Please note that this is a relatively easy path but if you opt for quicker ascent and a steeper path, you must walk at your own risk.

node.name: Mr. Richard Shinder on Liability Management and Debt Restructuring
node.descriptionText:
About the Event

As the macroeconomic landscape shifts and a massive "maturity wall" of corporate debt approaches, the demand for sophisticated liability management and debt restructuring has reached an all-time high.

Join us for an in-depth conversation with veteran Wall Street restructuring advisor Richard Shinder. He will discuss his career trajectory, the mechanics of complex debt restructurings, and what it takes to launch an independent boutique investment bank in today’s volatile market.

About the Speaker:

Richard Shinder is a Co-Founder and Partner at Ensis Partners, a New York-based boutique investment bank specializing in complex debt restructuring and capital solutions. With over three decades of financial services experience, he has successfully executed scores of transactions across financial restructuring, bankruptcy, and distressed investing. Prior to launching Ensis Partners in early 2026, Mr. Shinder founded Theatine Partners and served as the Group Head of Restructuring and Special Situations at Piper Jaffray. His extensive Wall Street background includes partner- and senior-level positions at Perella Weinberg Partners, Goldman Sachs, Avenue Capital, Blackstone, and Lehman Brothers. He holds an MBA with distinction from The Wharton School.

node.name: AI for Research and Writing Series Part 1
node.descriptionText:
Using artificial intelligence for research and writing has emerged as a helpful skillset in any scholar’s toolkit. AI tools can find sources, read and summarize articles, write text and code, manage workflows, and identify impactful research questions. In this workshop series, participants will reflect on their own research to identify opportunities for AI to boost their productivity and impact. Through hands-on practice with AI tools adopted by Yale, participants will explore how AI can advance their projects at each stage of the writing process. Join us for:

Intro to AI for Literature Reviews and Reading (11/6)
Intro to AI for Writing (11/13)
Workflow Management with AI (11/20)

Intended audience: Graduate students in all disciplines.

node.name: YSS Abroad in Quito Information Session
node.descriptionText: Quito is at the center of the planet Earth. The equator ("ecuador") is where North, South, East, and West meet. From the Andes Mountains, to the Pacific Coast, to the Amazon Region and the Galapagos, Ecuador is also gifted with an abundance of natural beauty. To learn more, join course instructors and alumni of YSS in Quito: Advanced Spanish and Andean Cultures next week for an information session. Pizza will be served!
